using VeryDiff, VNNLib
const n1 = load_onnx_model("/nets/net1.onnx")
const n2 = load_onnx_model("/nets/net2.onnx")
const EPS = 0.339949
VeryDiff.USE_DIFFZONO[] = true
function count(lo, hi)
    b = hcat(lo, hi)
    out = Pipe()
    local s
    redirect_stdout(devnull) do
        r = verify_network(n1, n2, b, get_epsilon_property(EPS), epsilon_split_heuristic)
    end
    return nothing
end
# capture via a string buffer
function countn(lo, hi)
    b = hcat(Float64.(lo), Float64.(hi))
    fn = tempname()
    open(fn, "w") do io
        redirect_stdout(io) do
            verify_network(n1, n2, b, get_epsilon_property(EPS), epsilon_split_heuristic)
        end
    end
    txt = read(fn, String)
    m = match(r"Processed (\d+) zonotopes", txt)
    return parse(Int, m.captures[1])
end

include("h.jl")
using Logging
global_logger(NullLogger())
const memo = Dict{Tuple{Vector{Float64},Vector{Float64}},Int}()
function cnt(lo,hi)
    k=(round.(lo,digits=9),round.(hi,digits=9))
    get!(memo,k) do; countn(lo,hi) end
end
function children(lo,hi,d,cuts)
    pts = vcat(lo[d], cuts, hi[d])
    [ (begin l=copy(lo); h=copy(hi); l[d]=pts[i]; h[d]=pts[i+1]; (l,h) end) for i in 1:length(pts)-1 ]
end
function candidates(lo,hi)
    c = []
    for d in 1:4
        w = hi[d]-lo[d]
        for f in (0.25,0.375,0.5,0.625,0.75)
            push!(c,(d,[lo[d]+f*w]))
        end
        push!(c,(d,[lo[d]+w/3, lo[d]+2w/3]))
        push!(c,(d,[lo[d]+w/4, lo[d]+w/2, lo[d]+3w/4]))
    end
    c
end
plan = []  # (lo,hi,d,cuts)
function solve(lo,hi,depth=0)
    n = cnt(lo,hi)
    if n==1; return 1; end
    best=typemax(Int); bc=nothing
    for (d,cuts) in candidates(lo,hi)
        s = sum(cnt(l,h) for (l,h) in children(lo,hi,d,cuts))
        if s<best; best=s; bc=(d,cuts); end
    end
    push!(plan,(copy(lo),copy(hi),bc[1],bc[2]))
    tot=1
    for (l,h) in children(lo,hi,bc[1],bc[2])
        tot += solve(l,h,depth+1)
    end
    tot
end
lo=fill(-1.0,4); hi=fill(1.0,4)
t = solve(lo,hi)
println("TOTAL ",t, " plan splits ", length(plan))
open("/scratch/plan.txt","w") do io
  for (l,h,d,c) in plan
    println(io, join(l,","),";",join(h,","),";",d,";",join(c,","))
  end
end
